title: Zapier 'Next Gen Zaps' (early access): import an existing Zap by link, see/edit the code behind it, tell an agent (Claude Code) to change it - e.g. rejoin split paths, which classic Zaps cannot do

tools.name: Zapier Next Gen Zaps
tools.detail: help-center page 'Get started with Next Gen Zaps': works with any MCP-capable AI client; plans Free/Professional/Team/Enterprise; early access via Zapier support > Early Access Products > Next Gen Zap Workflows

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: the agent that edits the imported Zap

tools.name: Google Sheets / Slack
tools.detail: demo Zap: New Spreadsheet Row -> Paths (Deal Value >= $10,000 -> #leads-enterprise, else #leads-nurture)

claims: Existing Zaps can be imported by link into Next Gen Zaps with the same workflow, now with inspectable code (Inputs -> Control flow -> Slack steps)
You can edit the diagram, edit the code, or instruct the agent in plain language
Classic Zaps cannot rejoin a split path, forcing duplicated steps; the agent merged both routes into one shared 'save lead to tracker' step
Review the change, test both routes, then publish
how_to_steps: Copy the link of an existing Zap
Open Next Gen Zaps and import it
Open the generated code / control-flow diagram
Tell the agent the change (e.g. 'after every Slack message, bring both paths together and save the lead to my tracker')
Review diff, test each route, publish
on_screen_only: Classic Zap diagram: 1. New Spreadsheet Row, 2. Split into paths, Path A Deal Value >= $10,000 -> Send to #leads-enterprise, Path B < $10,000 -> Send to #leads-nurture
Next Gen view: Inputs > Control flow > Slack 'Send To Leads Enterprise' > Control flow > Slack 'Send To Leads Nurture'; code pane with slack message JSON
Help center: 'Next Gen Zaps is in early access. Contact Zapier support and select Early Access Products > Next Gen Zap Workflows... in active development.'

relevance.why: If Haji runs any Zaps, turning them into agent-editable code is a cheap upgrade path and sidesteps classic Zap limits; otherwise informational.

implement_score.why: Request early access and import one Zap; low effort. Compare with just rewriting the automation as a Zapier SDK script (see the creator's other video).
